Message:
ALSA: hda/realtek: fix mute/micmute LEDs don't work for ProBook 440/460 G11.

HP ProBook 440/460 G11 needs ALC236_FIXUP_HP_GPIO_LED quirk to
make mic-mute/audio-mute working.
